content:
Babe, please, just listen to me for a second. I know what you think you saw, but it's not what you think. Honestly, you're overreacting. It was nothing, really. Just a misunderstanding. You always jump to the worst conclusions, don't you?

Remember that time you got mad about me talking to Sarah from work? And then it turned out she was just asking about a project? This is like that, but way less dramatic. You're making a mountain out of a molehill, sweetheart.

It's actually kind of hurtful that you'd think I'd do something like that. After everything we've been through? Don't you trust me at all? I thought we had something special, something real. And now you're just going to throw all of that away because of... what? A silly little incident that meant absolutely nothing?

Maybe you're just stressed lately. Or maybe you're projecting something from your past onto me. I've always been faithful to you, always. My heart is yours, you know that. You're just spiraling, and I don't like seeing you like this. It's not fair to either of us.

Why don't we just calm down, talk this through properly, and realize that this is all just a silly misunderstanding? You know I love you. You know I do. Don't let your imagination get the best of you, baby.
